findings.summary: Clipboard success and error messages are inserted without a status or alert role.
findings.fix: Add an empty persistent role=status region before copying, update its text with success or failure, and preserve the message long enough to be perceived; keep keyboard focus on the copy button.
findings.evidence: Creates span.clipboard-success and sets innerText to Copied! or Could not copy!; no aria-live/role; fades after 1 or 5 seconds.

findings.summary: The card update confirmation has no programmatic status announcement.
findings.fix: Give the existing empty .change-card-result span role=status before its text is updated; test return focus and confirmation with Stripe sandbox credentials.
findings.evidence: ; stripe-change-card.js calls .text("Card updated") on AJAX success.

passed: Donation setup error is displayed using a native alert dialog rather than an unannounced visual toast.
notes: Read-only audit did not execute payment or saved-card mutations.
Collapsing content needs expanded state and keyboard semantics rather than blanket live regions.
Static server-rendered form responses do not inherently require live regions.
